missing_information_behavior: If kidney condition type, renal status or medication context is unknown, retain professional-review override and do not generate an individualized vitamin D recommendation.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer vitamin D deficiency or prescribe a dose from kidney disease status alone.
Do not treat all stages or causes of kidney disease as equivalent.
Do not override clinician-directed vitamin D or active CKD-mineral bone disorder treatment.
professional_escalation_conditions: Chronic kidney disease, dialysis, transplant, abnormal calcium/phosphate or parathyroid results.
Known hypercalcemia, nephrolithiasis or use of active vitamin D analogues.
population_and_context: Users reporting kidney disease or impaired renal function who are being assessed for vitamin D; this is a safety escalation, not a contraindication for every kidney patient.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Assess 25(OH)D, calcium, phosphate, renal function and treatment context with the clinician where indicated.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Vitamin D fact sheet describes vitamin D metabolism, toxicity and clinical context; kidney-specific management requires nephrology guidance and current CKD guidelines. This justification remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
